name: reposeiri
description: Codex adapter for source-bound semantic repository audits, evidence-capped README appeal review, dry-run plans, and draft PR bodies.

interface.shortDescription: Review repository organization through typed RepoSeiri queries.
interface.longDescription: RepoSeiri 1.1 uses one source-bound Rust analysis, README grammar IR, program capability IR, and a claim-capability membrane to expose ten bounded queries for routes, evidence, governance, evidence-capped README appeal, existing-target-only dry-run plans, and draft PR bodies without granting file-write or GitHub authority.
defaultPrompt: Show safe and blocked repo fixes.
